Questionnaire Jorveza® Suspension Market Research –
Pre-Launch 2026
Introduction & Global Safety (Do not translate)
Dr. Falk Pharma will introduce Jorveza® Suspension, a new oral formulation for paediatric patients with Eosinophilic Esophagitis (EoE), at the end of this year.The suspension was developed to offer a locally acting therapy option for paediatric patients. The new formulation aims to offer a child-friendly, easy-to-administer treatment alternative that meets the needs of paediatric EoE patients and their caregivers.
To support a successful launch, Dr. Falk Pharma plans to conduct market research with two primary goals:
Build a solid understanding of the paediatric EoE landscape, including treatment pathways, physician behaviours, patient needs, unmet needs, and perceptions of current therapies across key markets.
Establish a measurable baseline of pre-launch KPIs that can be monitored regularly over time. This will allow us to track market readiness, awareness, adoption potential, and shifts in clinical decision-making after the introduction of Jorveza® Suspension.
Scope of Work (Do not translate)
Topic: Treatments for paediatric patients with Eosinophilic Esophagitis (EoE), Jorveza® suspension
Type of research: Quantitative survey, 20 minutes
Target audience: Paediatricians, Paediatric Gastroenterologists (80%) and Gastroenterologists (20%) -> best effort/soft quota
Countries: Germany (GER), Austria (AUT), Switzerland (SUI), France (FRA), Italy (ITA), Netherlands (NED), Sweden (SWE), Australia (AUS)
Remarks: n/a
Sample size: n=50 per country
Deliverables: Raw data, tables and report
Timetable: April to July
Note for PV:
Potentially AEs can be mentioned in all open-end questions
Further AE-relevant questions or combinations:
Just for PV stats: Q3a = 1 or 2 or 3 (less than 6 biopsies)
Just for PV stats: Q5 = 2 or 3 (Jorveza® “mostly as part of combination therapy” or “about equally often both” [mono&combo])
Just for PV stats: Q8a = 1 or 2 (NOT ongoing maintenance therapy) AND Q5a_3 > 0% (for Jorveza)
